title: Owner Auto Policy Tariff Card: Lapse-Length Charge on a Reinstatement with Lapse
content:
**Charge.** On a reinstatement with lapse of an Owner Auto Policy term, a lapse charge is added to the reinstatement fee. It depends on how long coverage lapsed before it was restored. The lapse is counted in calendar days from the cancellation effective date to the reinstatement effective date, with the cancellation effective date counted and the reinstatement effective date not counted.

| Lapse length | Charge added |
|---|---|
| 15 days or more | 10.00 |
| at least 8 and fewer than 15 days | 5.00 |
| fewer than 8 days | nothing |

**Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical).**
- A lapse of 14 days adds 5.00; a lapse of 15 days adds 10.00.
- A lapse of 7 days adds nothing; a lapse of 8 days adds 5.00.

**Reading the count (hypothetical).** A cancellation effective date of the 3rd and a reinstatement effective date of the 12th give a lapse of 9 days (the 3rd through the 11th), so 5.00 is added.
